name: clio3-eps-write-vin
label: Modus / Clio III EPS — write VIN
description: Writes a VIN and its CRC to the steering column.
warning: Writes the VIN into the steering column. A wrong VIN or CRC leaves the module paired to a vehicle that does not exist.
_unverified: Not run against a vehicle. Slug and request names are checked against the database; the effect is not.
